description:
Park Jong-hwa (pen name: Vish), author of the romance fantasy novel Beyond the Hours of Dawn, gets into a bus accident on the way to an event at his own fan café. Expecting to wake up badly injured, Jong-hwa instead opens his eyes to find himself not in a hospital—but in a strange bed inside the very world of his novel. What’s worse, he hasn’t become the main character or even a supporting role, but an utter background extra. In order to somehow return to reality, he starts plotting toward the one ironclad rule of “transmigration stories”: reaching the ending. But wait… why is the second male lead, Ronen, acting so strange? 

A tear-jerking, laugh-out-loud transmigration escape story about a writer trapped inside his own novel—ranked No. 1 in “must-escape” scenarios!
